50 | Sensory Merge | caster | C | unlimited | Fm

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster gains double normal hearing. This results in a special bonus of +50 to
Awareness - Searching and Awareness - Senses skills involving only hearing (or
+5 for Alertness skill). This bonus is +25 to such skills involving hearing
and other senses (or +3 for Alertness skill).
@@ 2
Caster can see 100' on a clear night as if it were day. At least some small
amount of residual light is required for this spell to work. See Section 15.12
(p. 98).
@@ 3
Caster has a 300° field of vision. The flank bonus is reduced to +5 and the
rear bonus is reduced to +15.
@@ 4
Caster can check one object or place (up to a 5' radius) and tell if it is an
illusion or has an illusion on it.
@@ 5
As Nightvision, except affects vision underwater (and other liquids).
@@ 6
As Sly Ears except caster gains an extremely acute sense of smell and the
bonuses indicated apply to Awareness skills involving smelling.
@@ 7
As Nightvision, except works in any precipitation or gas. See Section 15.12
(p. 98).
@@ 8
Caster gains extreme tactile sensitivity. This results in a special bonus of
+25 to all actions that depend on tactile sense (e.g., pick locks, disarm
traps, etc.).
@@ 9
As Nightvision, except no light is required and caster can see even in
magically created darkness.
@@ 10
Caster can pick a point up to 100' per level away and he will hear as if he
were at that point (there can be intervening objects such as walls); he must
have been at the location before or the location must be within his field of
vision.
@@ 11
As Mentalist Ear, except caster can see instead of listening.
@@ 12
For the duration of the spell, one illusion within the area of effect ceases
to exist (for the caster only). Caster must know that something is an illusion
before this spell is cast.
@@ 13
As Detect Illusion, except caster can check one object or place per round.
@@ 14
As all lower level Vision spells functioning at the same time.
@@ 15
As Nightvision, except range is the range of normal daylight vision.
@@ 17
As Disillusion, except all illusions within range cease to exist for the
caster. Caster need not be aware of any illusions within the range before
casting this spell.
@@ 18
As in Watervision, except range is the range of normal daylight vision.
@@ 19
As Fogvision, except range is the range normal daylight vision.
@@ 20
As all lower level Vision True spells functioning at the same time.
@@ 25
As Mentalist Ear, except range is 1 mile per level.
@@ 30
As Mentalist Eye, except range is 1 mile per level.
@@ 50
Caster can ''merge'' his senses with those of a subject whose exact location
is known. Exact location can be established through a prior arrangement. If
target of spell is not at the specified location, the PPs for this spell are
still expended.
